reading: The sketch lays out a Kanban-style sprint board: a top filter/search toolbar, four column headers (To do, In progress, Review, Done) with counts, and two horizontally-scrolling lanes ("WEB APP" and "MOBILE") separated by dashed dividers, each containing a column of labeled, tagged task cards (some with progress bars, avatar dots, or a struck-through 'done' look). All text content, colors, and spacing were given precisely via typed notes anchored to each stroke.
